install.helpIntro: NurtureHUB installs straight from your browser — there is no app store download.
install.iosStep1: Tap the Share button in Safari's toolbar.
install.iosStep2: Scroll down and choose "Add to Home Screen".
install.iosStep3: Tap Add — NurtureHUB now opens like any other app.
install.otherStep1: Open the browser menu (⋮ in Chrome, ··· in Edge).
install.otherStep2: Choose "Install app" or "Add to Home screen".
install.otherStep3: Confirm — NurtureHUB opens in its own window.
install.benefits: Installed, NurtureHUB opens instantly, works without internet, and can send you notifications.

locked.title: Opens after your selection
locked.body: Adoptions and the Growth Monitor open once you are selected for face-to-face training. Until then, finish your videos and tests on the Dashboard.
